# ash_authentication_oauth2_server v0.2.2 - Table of Contents

> An OAuth 2.1 authorization server for Ash Framework apps — RFC 7591 dynamic
client registration, PKCE, audience-bound JWTs, refresh-token rotation, and
a built-in consent flow on top of ash_authentication + Phoenix.

## GUIDES

- [Home](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

- Topics
  - [Reading scopes from an access token](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/scopes.md)

## Modules

- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.md): An OAuth 2.1 authorization server, configured per app via a single module.
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.AuthorizationCodeResource](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.AuthorizationCodeResource.md): Resource extension for OAuth 2.1 authorization-code rows.
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.AuthorizationCodeResource.Actions](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.AuthorizationCodeResource.Actions.md): Action helpers for resources extended with
`AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.AuthorizationCodeResource`.

- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.AuthorizationCodeResource.Info](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.AuthorizationCodeResource.Info.md): Introspection helpers for the
`AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.AuthorizationCodeResource` extension.

- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.AuthorizationCodeResource.Verifier](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.AuthorizationCodeResource.Verifier.md): Verifies that an OAuth2 authorization-code resource declares every
attribute the `Authorize` and `Token` cores read or write.
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Authorize](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Authorize.md): Protocol-pure logic for the `/oauth/authorize` endpoint.
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Changes.RotateRefreshToken](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Changes.RotateRefreshToken.md): Change that rotates a refresh-token row atomically.
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Expunger](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Expunger.md): A `GenServer` which periodically removes expired OAuth2 authorization
codes and refresh tokens.
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Jwt](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Jwt.md): Mint and verify OAuth 2.1 access tokens.
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Metadata](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Metadata.md): Builders for the discovery metadata endpoints.
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.PKCE](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.PKCE.md): PKCE (RFC 7636) S256 helpers.
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.RefreshTokenResource](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.RefreshTokenResource.md): Resource extension for OAuth 2.1 refresh-token rows.
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.RefreshTokenResource.Actions](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.RefreshTokenResource.Actions.md): Action helpers for resources extended with
`AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.RefreshTokenResource`.

- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.RefreshTokenResource.Info](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.RefreshTokenResource.Info.md): Introspection helpers for the
`AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.RefreshTokenResource` extension.

- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.RefreshTokenResource.Verifier](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.RefreshTokenResource.Verifier.md): Verifies the refresh-token resource has the shape the Token core
depends on
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Register](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Register.md): Protocol-pure logic for `/oauth/register` (RFC 7591 Dynamic Client
Registration).
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Supervisor](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Supervisor.md): Supervises the background processes for an OAuth2 server.
- [AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Token](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Oauth2Server.Token.md): Protocol-pure logic for the `/oauth/token` endpoint.
- [AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.BearerPlug](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.BearerPlug.md): Resource-server side bearer token validation.
- [AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.ConsentRouter](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.ConsentRouter.md): Plug router for the human-driven consent step of the OAuth 2.1 flow.
- [AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.ConsentView](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.ConsentView.md): Default HTML consent screen.
- [AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.Errors](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.Errors.md): HTTP error response helpers for OAuth 2.1 / RFC 7591.

- [AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.ProtocolRouter](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.ProtocolRouter.md): Plug router for the client-facing OAuth 2.1 protocol endpoints — anything
called by an external OAuth client without a browser session.
- [AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.Router](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/AshAuthentication.Phoenix.Oauth2Server.Router.md): Phoenix router macros for mounting the OAuth 2.1 authorization server.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ash_authentication_oauth2_server.install](https://ash-authentication-oauth2-server.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshAuthenticationOauth2Server.Install.md): Scaffolds an OAuth 2.1 authorization server
